projectContext: Sprint 25 continues test infrastructure maturity after Sprint 24 completed subdirectory READMEs, flaky test infrastructure, benchmark CI config, test helpers module, and coverage scripts. This sprint focuses on: (1) helpers/fixtures README documentation, (2) expanding parametrize usage to 50+ new cases, (3) marking 200+ network-dependent tests as flaky, (4) adding agent healer assertion helpers, (5) enabling benchmark CI regression detection, (6) consolidating duplicate test patterns, and (7) improving marker coverage from 25% to 50%.
